scope: Real Office EX desktop entry, native file capabilities, isolated PPT/PPTX saves and PDF output; Linux headless is not a physical display/IME/printer or other-platform certificate.
checks: Real desktop boots with sandbox and restricted preload
Forged native presentation/export capabilities and caller PDF bytes rejected
Slides desktop edits text, vectors, embedded image, pages and presentation
Isolated PDF export preserves three pages, Unicode text, source bytes and clean state
Main-owned verifier saves PPTX and converts an independent PPT tab without changing source
Legacy PPT reopens, edits, saves in original format and independently reparses
Legacy PPT converts back to a real PPTX through the shared model
All 22 native UI locales switch without changing presentation revision or geometry direction
Native PDF tab loads local worker/fonts, searches text and navigates pages
Read-only PDF Save As preserves original bytes exactly
PDF native print invokes a sandboxed child and interactive print settings (physical printer callback stubbed)
New PDF assets keep external/file fetch blocked and output windows are destroyed
Consecutive native PPTX saves retain imported layout identity after reordering
